# S576 — spec draft: keep the role's raw report when the report shape check fails, and name its path in the error

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

On 2026-11-25, `ork spec draft ork S531 --json` failed three times in a row with "report shape: no block for Why; no block for Files; no block for Failing tests; no block for Implement; no block for Check". Drafts for S572, S573 and S565 succeeded in the same hour. The error names no file, and neither the daemon log nor the state dir keeps the role's raw report, so the orchestrator cannot see what the role wrote or why the parser found no blocks.

When the report shape check fails, ork should keep the raw report under the state dir and print its path in the error, so the failure can be diagnosed without re-running the draft.
